Getting started

Agent Page Extract turns a public webpage into clean markdown for a retrieval pipeline. The reader keeps the article body so a language model can quote the page without the surrounding chrome.

ALPHA-PHRASE-ARTICLE marks the sentence that should survive extraction. Teams paste this markdown into an assistant, a vector index, or a documentation crawl.

The same body can be returned as plain text when a pipeline wants words without heading marks. Word count and the token estimate both use that plain text.
